name: @stonedogcode/howto-mcp
description: A Model Context Protocol server for a how-to documentation portal: search articles and read them, as the user whose token you hold.
author: StoneDogCode L.L.C.

scripts.gate: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.//publish:howto-mcp: Publish to npm, end to end. Run from a terminal, interactively -- npm prompts for the 2FA one-time password and the login flow needs a browser. It refuses a checkout that is detached, dirty, or behind origin/main, runs the gate and verify:package, reads the tarball, then proves the result by installing from the registry and running it.
scripts.//verify:package: Pack, install into a temp directory as a consumer, and RUN the installed binary. The running is the point: this ships compiled ESM behind a bin, and tsc accepts extension-less relative imports it does not rewrite on emit -- so a green gate can sit on top of a build Node refuses to start. Nothing else catches that.
